messages:
Ivy (People Ops): Quick ping  we're merging two short sections into a single "manager-approved schedule exceptions" policy and need a tiny rollout: wording reviewers (2 ppl) + one owner for the manager ack tracker and RSVP flow. Publish target: 2026-05-03.

Dan P: I can take a wording pass today. What's the scope?

Ivy (People Ops): Keep it <300 words. Clarify approval flow, example for on-call overlap, and a line about contractors (recommended only). Training: two 20-min drop-ins on 2026-04-21 & 2026-04-28.

Rhea (Legal): I'll do a legal sweep for EU/UK/DE language. Quick note: avoid wording that implies contractors get paid leave.

Tomas (Localization): We'll need short strings for FR/DE/ES. If you avoid idioms we can localize fast.

Jo: I can run the RSVP sheet and completion receipts. Share CSV header and I'll wire the automations.

Ivy (People Ops): CSV header (exact order):
```csv
manager_name,team,email,completed(yes/no),completion_ts,session,verifier,notes
```
We rely on header order for automated exports.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled  RSVP ping 7 days before first session; completion nudges 48h before publish date.

Dan P: Wording pass done  renamed to "Manager-authorized schedule exceptions" and added one-line example about swapping on-call shifts. Kept contractor line as "recommended" per Rhea.

Rhea (Legal): Reviewed. Added short clause for DE: managers must document expected duration when remote exceeds 2 weeks. No other legal blockers.

Tomas (Localization): Good to translate once final text is in. Suggest avoid "flex credits" term.

Jo: I'll seed tracker with managers from eng/product and share link. Will set up auto receipts to send to the email column.

Ivy (People Ops): Action list: 1) Dan finalize wording today; 2) Rhea confirm small DE sentence by 2026-04-10; 3) Tomas prepare localized strings after final; 4) Jo build tracker + automations by 2026-04-12; 5) Ivy publish 2026-05-03. PR will be posted here.

Jo: FYI I'll also export completion CSV nightly to the compliance bucket for reporting.

Ivy (People Ops): PR opened: https://git.company/handbook/policies/manager-schedule-exceptions-2026  please review. Thanks all!
